elements.name: create
elements.brief: Reads an atlas animation's frames for a sprite that uses the repeat material,
elements.description:
Reads an atlas animation's frames for a sprite that uses the repeat material,
and returns a handle that applies them. Apply the repeat material to the sprite
first, and disable sprite trim mode for the atlas images: every frame must have
exactly 8 UV values, or this asserts. Walks the atlas animation's frame list,
so it needs Defold 1.12.3 or later.

parameters.name: sprite_id
parameters.doc:
The atlas animation to read. When omitted, the sprite's current
`animation` is used.

parameters.name: self
parameters.doc:
The calling script's `self`. When it already holds `atlas_data` and
`tex_info`, they are reused instead of read again; otherwise they are read and
stored on it, so later calls for sprites sharing the atlas skip the lookup.
types: { atlas_data?: ReturnType<typeof resource.get_atlas>; tex_info?: ReturnType<typeof resource.get_texture_info>; }

functions.name: animate
functions.brief: Applies the first frame and the repeat factors to the sprite. When the
functions.description:
Applies the first frame and the repeat factors to the sprite. When the
animation has more than one frame and a non-zero `fps`, starts a repeating
timer that steps through the frames.

parameters.name: repeat_x
parameters.doc: How many times the image repeats horizontally.

parameters.name: repeat_y
parameters.doc: How many times the image repeats vertically.

functions.name: stop
functions.brief: Cancels the playback timer, if one is running.
functions.description: Cancels the playback timer, if one is running.

properties.name: frames
properties.brief: Every frame of the animation, in playback order.
properties.description: Every frame of the animation, in playback order.

properties.name: width
properties.brief: The animation's width, from the atlas.
properties.description: The animation's width, from the atlas.

properties.name: height
properties.brief: The animation's height, from the atlas.
properties.description: The animation's height, from the atlas.

properties.name: fps
properties.brief: The animation's playback rate, from the atlas.
properties.description: The animation's playback rate, from the atlas.

properties.name: current_frame
properties.brief: The 1-based index of the frame shown next.
properties.description: The 1-based index of the frame shown next.

properties.name: v
properties.brief: The `uv_repeat` value: `x`/`y` the repeat factors, `z`/`w` the current frame's size.
properties.description: The `uv_repeat` value: `x`/`y` the repeat factors, `z`/`w` the current frame's size.
